accessibility.focus: Inherited blue 3px outline / 4px offset; bento uses orange 3px / 4px, branches orange 2px / 3px.
accessibility.motion: Optional engines disabled for reduced motion, Calm, high contrast, forced colors, hidden document and inactive views. Fine hover pointers gate bento tilt/spotlight. disableAnimations recreates and resets the bento engine.
accessibility.transparency: GlassLayer becomes opaque for reduced transparency, high contrast or forced colors. Touch/reduced motion keeps frosted glass without SVG refraction.
accessibility.contrast: Final glass-theme.css overrides muted and line colors; atmosphere hidden for reduced transparency/high contrast; forced colors restores system surfaces/borders.
accessibility.navigation: Single labeled rail/dock tree, native project/branch links, collapsed branches aria-hidden and inert; native modal focus/scroll behavior preserved.
accessibility.preferences: V2-specific System/Light/Dark, Calm and Atmosphere persistence.

extensions.rampProvenance: Tonal ramps are synthesized OKLCH panel previews from each source color's hue and chroma, with stepped lightness. They are not implemented CSS tokens or new usage rules; translucent source colors are previewed without alpha.
extensions.snippetScope: Self-contained source-derived visual specimens. Glass/bento shows the implemented frosted fallback; Tech Text shows the implemented DOM fallback; expanded branch markup shows actual visual geometry. Real refraction, Canvas interactions, bento engine, and folding/state handlers run in the app. No vendor sample content is presented as portfolio content. Botanical and Risograph snippets resolve tokens to literal Sunlit / Cream paper values so they render the same whatever style the host carries; grain, mottle, plants and moving plates run in the app.

glassSurface.refraction: Fine hover pointer and no reduced-motion request. The decorative layer is inert and sits behind content.

techText.fallback: DOM h1 when effects disabled; hidden accessible name when canvas enabled; capped device pixel ratio 2 and offscreen pausing.

magicBento.content: Actual featured manifest projects and a project-index anchor.

branchedMenu.selection: Controlled from route parameters; native anchors and SVG chevron; collapsed content inert.

extensions.breakpointBehavior: Desktop rail defaults to 240px; resizes from 200px to min(360px, max(240px, 32% viewport)); workspace offset equals width + 36px. <=800 rail 68px / workspace 90px; <=600 floating dock, 14px gutters, portrait/contact row and strengths below. Bento measures its container using 150px minimum cells and 200px pair cells.

homepageAssembly.opening: Layout alone draws persistent measured outlines; the crew joins to fill the real surfaces
homepageAssembly.label: 10px / 650 Geist, 3px radius, #071528 ink
homepageAssembly.ownership: Refs onto existing components; lifecycle-scoped GSAP presentation styles; no UI copies or remount
homepageAssembly.replay: Header control, Homepage assembly preference, and ?replayIntro=1
homepageAssembly.bypass: Reduced motion, Calm, increased contrast, forced colors, disabled flag, and ?intro=0
homepageAssembly.interrupt: Input, focus, scroll, navigation, resize, visibility, font and observed geometry changes
homepageAssembly.guideCorners: Measured border-top-left-radius of the real target

narrative.overview:
V2 is one site with one content model, one route map and one component tree, printed in three site styles chosen under Settings → Site style and applied as `:root[data-style]`. **Botanical** is the default (`data-style="botanical"`, also the value an unknown or missing preference resolves to); **Original** is the blue/orange glass design, kept intact for anyone who chooses it (`data-style="original"`); **Risograph** prints the site in fluorescent pink, cobalt and yellow ink on paper (`data-style="riso"`). Each style has its own light and dark printing: Original's Light/Dark, Botanical's Sunlit/Moonlit, Risograph's Cream paper/Black paper. The root `index.html` pre-paint script sets `data-style`, the browser chrome colour and the style's display-face stylesheet before first paint, so no style flashes another.

The unscoped base (`glass-theme.css`, `styles.css`, `layout.css`) is Original. Botanical (`botanical/botanical.css`) and Risograph (`riso/riso.css`) are complete overlay layers: every rule they ship is scoped under their own `data-style` selector (the shared Site style picker and the page-background art are the only unscoped exceptions), and they reach the shared components by remapping the shared custom properties (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--ink`, `--muted`, `--line`, `--blue`, `--orange`, `--glass-*`, `--panel-shadow`, `--accent-fill*`) rather than by forking markup. Frontmatter keys without a prefix are Original; `botanical-` and `riso-` keys belong to those styles, and `-dark-` keys are each style's dark printing.

**Original — "Personal glass workspace."** Ice-blue or deep navy ground, refractive glass, blue light, orange actions and orbital geometry give practical information work a vivid interactive setting. Geist and consistent line icons keep the material system legible. Tech Text, Magic Bento, Branched Menu and Glass Surface define the experience; the atmosphere drifts when effects are enabled.

**Botanical — "The conservatory."** A lush, earthy field journal: matte grained paper panels on a parchment ground, a deep forest-green rail like a journal's binding, Fraunces display type with a soft optical axis, leaf-cut corners, and living plants drawn in SVG (ferns, monstera, pothos, tradescantia) that grow, unfurl and sway. Pip, the resident pothos, lengthens as you scroll and can be watered. Moonlit turns the paper to deep green and swaps the green accent for amber.

**Risograph — "The print run."** Every view is a sheet pulled from a three-drum press: warm newsprint with fibre grain, fluorescent pink, cobalt and golden-yellow inks that overprint where they meet, and hierarchy carried by ink, scale and overprint instead of panels and shadows. Archivo condensed caps set names, headings and big figures; display type and prints sit a plate off register and pull into register on hover. Black paper keeps the same inks, mixed opaque for dark stock.
keyCharacteristics: Three complete site styles over one component tree, switched by `:root[data-style]`, each with a light and a dark printing.
Original: ice-blue/navy glass with orange actions, blue illumination and refraction behind content.
Botanical (default): grained paper, forest-green binding, Fraunces display, leaf-cut corners and living SVG plants.
Risograph: newsprint, three overprinting inks, condensed Archivo caps, 2px corners, 1.5px ink rules and deliberate misregistration.
The CliftonStrengths domain colours are product data and stay identical in every style.
Every style honours Calm, reduced motion, high contrast and forced colours by removing ornament, never content.

rules.name: The Semantic Glass Rule
rules.body: In Original, use live theme variables for glass, text, and supporting UI; retain the implemented fixed orange primary-action palette.

rules.name: The Remap, Don't Fork Rule
rules.body: A style changes the shared components by redefining the shared custom properties under its own `:root[data-style]` selector, scoped to that selector, so the other two styles stay pixel-identical.

rules.name: The Deep Ink Rule
rules.body: In Risograph, fluorescent pink and yellow are fills and shapes; text that must be read is set in `riso-pink-text`, `riso-pink-display`, cobalt or navy, and anything printed on pink or yellow carries `riso-ink-on-color`.

rules.name: The Fixed Domains Rule
rules.body: The four CliftonStrengths domain colours are data and print the same in every style and theme.

rules.name: The Text Above Refraction Rule
rules.body: In Original, keep rendered text and controls outside the distortion layer; the glass filter belongs behind their content.

rules.name: The Condensed Fallback Rule
rules.body: Risograph's display stack names condensed faces before any wide fallback, so the poster layout survives a missing webfont.

rules.name: The Opaque Escape Rule
rules.body: Preserve the implemented fallbacks so readability and operation remain available when refraction, transparency, or motion is suppressed.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: In Risograph, nothing casts a shadow: separation is a 1.5px ink rule, a solid ink flood, or an overprint.

rules.name: The Overprint Rule
rules.body: Risograph inks that overlap blend (`multiply` on Cream paper, `screen` on Black paper, through `--r-blend`); never stack them opaquely when they are meant to overprint.

dos: **Do** scope every style-specific rule under its own `:root[data-style="…"]` selector and reach shared components by remapping the shared custom properties.
**Do** give each style both printings: Light/Dark for Original, Sunlit/Moonlit for Botanical, Cream paper/Black paper for Risograph.
**Do** keep the CliftonStrengths domain colours identical in every style and theme.
**Do** use ice-blue/navy glass with readable orange actions and blue illumination in Original, and keep Glass Surface refraction behind text and controls.
**Do** use the actual Tech Text, Magic Bento and Branched Menu implementations for signature interactions in Original.
**Do** set Botanical headings, legends and the wordmark in Fraunces over Geist body, on grained paper with leaf-cut or pill corners and the forest-green rail.
**Do** keep Botanical's plants decorative SVG (`aria-hidden`) and let them grow, unfurl and sway only when motion is welcome.
**Do** set Risograph names, headings and big figures in condensed (62%) Archivo caps, and let dates and numbers be the large type.
**Do** separate Risograph surfaces with 1.5px ink rules and solid floods, overprint inks through `--r-blend`, and put text on pink or yellow in `riso-ink-on-color`.
**Do** confine Risograph misregistration to display type and prints (the name, view titles, the portrait plates) and pull it into register on hover or focus.
**Do** drop ornament (plants, prints, plates, grain, texture) under high contrast and forced colours, and keep content, state and navigation available when effects are off.
**Do** retain native project links, visible navigation labels and title-first index rows in every style.
donts: **Don't** let a Botanical or Risograph rule leak outside its `data-style` scope; Original and the other styles must stay pixel-identical.
**Don't** propagate the V2 system into V1 or root design context.
**Don't** distort text or controls inside Original's refraction layer.
**Don't** reintroduce glass refraction or backdrop blur on Botanical or Risograph surfaces.
**Don't** give Risograph surfaces a box-shadow; depth there is ink, rule and overprint.
**Don't** set small Risograph text in fluorescent `riso-pink` or `riso-yellow`.
**Don't** replace real portfolio content with vendor demo tiles or decorative metrics.
**Don't** rely on optional effects to expose content, state, or navigation.
